description:
This week on the podcast, Marvel Comics Vice President and Executive Editor Nick Lowe hosts a roundtable discussion with the trio of writers behind The Amazing Spider-Man/Venom: Death Spiral crossover event! Join Al Ewing (All-New Venom), Joe Kelly (Amazing Spider-Man), and Charles Soule (Eddie Brock: Carnage) as they share behind-the-scenes details and a peek at what’s coming in the epic conclusion of Death Spiral! Plus, we’re checking in with everyone’s favorite girl next door, Mary Jane Watson, as we explore her rich comic book history! All time codes are approximate.
